name: tectonic-plate
notes: Tectonic plates divide up the Earth’s crust. Earthquakes and volcanic activity are mostly concentrated along the boundaries of these plates. Many earthquakes happen around the mid-ocean ridges and the major faults that occur at the plates’ boundaries.

organization.description: The Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX) is an open data sharing platform managed by the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs. The HDX organization is managed by the HDX data team and is used to share data on behalf of a number of partners

title: Earth Tectonic Plates

resources.description:
The PLATES Project has compiled digital data representing the Present-Day plate boundaries. The data were digitized from a number of sources.
The University of Texas Institute for Geophysics (UTIG) PLATES program was dedicated to the research of plate tectonics and geologic reconstructions.
